_note: Languages offered by the Study 7 survey. Adding a language: drop its strings file (same keys as strings_en_v8.json, at the same version) into this folder, add a line here, and run tools/check-font-coverage.mjs for it. A language appears only if its entry in asrs_official_transcriptions_v1.json has a status beginning with 'verbatim'. label is the language's own name for the selector.
